arms.task_template: Open the very top drawer directly underneath the countertop on the {side} of the robot's starting position. This is the highest drawer in that stack, above every other drawer. Pulling out a lower drawer while the top drawer stays shut is failure. The target must finish open by at least 52.25% of its front-to-back depth, just over half. Holding the handle is allowed.

Open the very top drawer directly underneath the countertop on the {side} of the robot's starting position. Identify this drawer front in the initial frames and keep tracking that same front throughout the video. This is the highest drawer in that stack, above every other drawer. Pulling out a lower drawer while the top drawer stays shut is failure. The target must finish open by at least 52.25% of its front-to-back depth, just over half. Holding the handle is allowed.

Open the very top drawer directly underneath the countertop on the {side} of the robot's starting position. The target can be a shallow drawer directly above cabinet doors. This is the highest drawer in that stack, above every other drawer. Pulling out a lower drawer while the top drawer stays shut is failure. The target must finish open by at least 52.25% of its front-to-back depth, just over half. Holding the handle is allowed.
